specification_vs_kernel.spec: Evaluate all dimensions independently, then apply work-decision precedence. Reason-code traces were pre-registered as the codes belonging to the winning path, not the full independent set.
specification_vs_kernel.misunderstanding: First kernel emitted every independent flag (causal match, evidence current, duplicate) even when a higher-precedence work_decision had already been chosen, and applied history-duplicate to cover proposals.
specification_vs_kernel.kernel_wrong: Yes, relative to the pre-registered traces: extra codes and cover-as-duplicate.

logic_changed: History duplicate applies only to non-cover causal proposals with the same controlling fingerprint and unsatisfied target.

reason_codes emitted for the chosen work_decision path: target identity/reality/satisfaction/completion always; DUPLICATE_TARGET only if work_decision=duplicate; COVER only on rejected/needs_clarification cover; NO_ACTIONABLE_STEP only if no_actionable_target; ACTIONABLE/CAUSAL/EVIDENCE_CURRENT/authority/eligibility codes only if admitted.
